name: Caring For The Sick
overview: Scripture reveals that caring for the sick is a divine mandate rooted in God's compassionate nature and His promise to heal and restore. The Lord Himself declares His intention to bind up the brokenhearted and strengthen the sick, demonstrating that healing is both a spiritual and physical restoration (Isaiah 61:1; Ezekiel 34:16). Believers are called to faithfully tend to those in need, reflecting God's heart by feeding and caring for His flock rather than neglecting them (Ezekiel 34:3). Ultimately, this care anticipates the glorious return of Christ, who will judge and reward those who have ministered to the vulnerable (Matthew 25:31).
